queries.query:
I have a bunch of API files from our backend team and need help getting them ready for our partners.
I need to turn our exported internal API collection into a clean OpenAPI spec and partner guide.

Our REST API has been growing fast and things are starting to feel messy—can you help me sort it out?
We want an audit of naming and schema inconsistencies across our endpoints, plus a v2 deprecation plan.

我們最近要調整對外的 API 規格，想先請你幫忙看一下怎麼處理比較好。
我們要把對外 API 從 v1 升到 v2，需要向後相容的遷移規範和本機模擬測試環境。

手邊有幾份 OpenAPI 的東西還沒整理好，前端跟維運都在等，能協助嗎？
我想先用草稿生出前端要用的模擬資料，並定好維運需要的健康與就緒檢查端點契約。

Our web app UI feels outdated and clunky—can you help us improve the frontend design?
I'd like to redesign our analytics dashboard from current screenshots into cleaner HTML and CSS.

We're building a new interface for our product and want it to look consistent across screens.
We want to unify our UI components into one design system with typography, color tokens, and states.

我們網站的前端畫面在手機跟暗黑模式下好像有點怪怪的，可以幫我調整嗎？
想請你檢查手機排版與暗黑模式對比問題，並給我修正後的 CSS 變數與無障礙元件調整。

我正在做一個新的桌面端產品介面設計，有一些版面與元件的問題想請你幫忙。
我需要一份符合原生規範的桌面版面設計規格，以及支援鍵盤導覽的無障礙元件結構。

Our site's search traffic hasn't been great lately—can you take a look at our SEO?
I have crawl exports and ranking data, and need a prioritized plan to fix indexing and canonical issues.

We want more organic visibility for our product pages and blog, where should we start?
We need a revenue-focused SEO roadmap to fix weak landing-page metadata and add structured data.

我們網站最近要調整架構跟網址，很怕搜尋排名掉下來，可以幫忙規劃嗎？
我需要一份無流量流失的網址遷移檢查清單，包含 301 轉址對應規則與上線後索引監控。

手上有一些關鍵字和競爭對手的資料，想優化一下網站內容跟連結結構。
想根據競品搜尋缺口設計主題群內部連結架構與內容翻新範本，拉升底部漏斗頁面排名。

We have some launch announcements and media ready—can you help us handle social media publishing?
I need our launch copy and media adapted for three channels, queued for publishing, and verified live.

Our team keeps running into headaches when posting across multiple social channels each week.
We want an automated weekly publishing queue with media checks, session validation, and live post confirmation.

我寫好了一些內容也準備了圖片跟影片，想安排發到幾個社群平台上，該怎麼弄？
我想把長文與短影音依各平台比例與字數限制排成草稿，並在正式發出後確認上線。

最近社群排程常漏發或搞錯帳號公開權限，想請你幫我整理一下發布流程。
我需要發文前帳號與公開權限的防呆檢查表，以及登入過期或上傳失敗時的補發恢復流程。

Our automated test suite is giving us a lot of trouble in CI—can you help fix it?
Our end-to-end checkout tests keep flaking on timeouts in CI, so we need them stabilized.

We need to set up test automation for our app, including browser and mobile coverage.
We need a framework recommendation, clean test folder structure, and a local-versus-cloud execution matrix.

我們想把舊的自動化測試整理一下，順便補齊關鍵流程的測試保護，可以怎麼做？
我需要一份分階段遷移到現代化瀏覽器測試架構的指南，並先重寫登入與結帳流程。

目前的測試跑起來很慢又常莫名其妙紅燈，想請你協助重構測試架構。
想清理重複程式碼與寫死的等待時間，並設定平行分片跑測和失敗自動蒐集除錯檔案。
